description.value: King Edward Hotel & Motel is a full-service small-town accommodation in Stewart, BC, a remote border community at the end of the Portland Canal across from Alaska's Misty Fjords National Park. The property offers multiple room types from standard queens to kitchenette suites, and operates an onsite pub and café, making it a practical overnight base in one of northwestern BC's most dramatically scenic corners. The surrounding area offers glacier access, bear viewing at Fish Creek, and estuary boardwalk walks within minutes of the front door.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and content-rich for King Edward Hotel & Motel in Stewart, BC. The amenities page and rooms page confirm Wi-Fi ('free Wi-Fi'), coin-operated guest laundry ('Guest Laundry Facility'), and onsite food and drink (Casey's Pub / Prospectors Pub and King Ed Cafe). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, drying rooms, e-bike charging, or tools appears anywhere on the site. OSM name is 'King Edward Motel' while the website consistently uses 'King Edward Hotel & Motel' — flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this as 'King Edward Motel' but the website consistently uses 'King Edward Hotel & Motel' — the OSM record may be an incomplete or outdated name.
OSM has no address or phone — these were sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel and motel in Stewart, BC with a live website, online booking, and full amenity details. Clear value to touring cyclists passing through this remote northern BC community.
